metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6→completion in 2 years) and T08 (TRL 5→completion in 2 years) are marginally feasible, but T03 (TRL 7) is scheduled for a 0-quarter development window (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1), which is effectively zero development time — a critical realism failure.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes mid-to-high TRL technologies (TRL 5-7) rather than the lower-TRL exploratory work expected of a 기술선도 strategy; while T08 at TRL 5 shows some exploratory intent, T03 at TRL 7 is near-market and contradicts the technology leadership positioning.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies are well within the Autonomous Driving/ADAS domain — sensor fusion, pose estimation, and steer-by-wire are core ADAS building blocks — demonstrating solid domain alignment and reasonable differentiation logic through dependency chaining.
evidence.market_timing: All three technologies complete significantly after their respective boom windows: T01 misses by 0.75yr, T08 by 2.25yr, and T03 by 2.0yr; for a 기술선도 strategy requiring pre-boom completion, these delays represent systematic failure to achieve timing advantage.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies are established ADAS categories with known patent and market activity, but there is no explicit evidence that convergence-zone analysis drove selection — the choices appear domain-logical rather than deliberately convergence-targeted.

strengths: All technologies are firmly within the Autonomous Driving/ADAS core domain, ensuring competitive relevance and leveraged existing organizational capabilities.
Dependency chain (T01→T08→T03) is logically structured and technically coherent, with zero dependency violations.
weaknesses: 스테어 바이 와이어 제어 (T03) has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), making it technically infeasible as planned.
All technologies miss their market boom windows by significant margins (0.75–2.25 years late), undermining both competitive timing and the 기술선도 preemption objective.
missing_technologies: Low-TRL AI-based end-to-end autonomous driving decision systems (TRL 2-4) to genuinely embody 기술선도 strategy
LiDAR-camera deep fusion algorithms or neuromorphic sensing approaches for next-generation differentiation
V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) communication integration technology to complement sensor fusion pipeline
investment_issues: Budget is fully exhausted (100% utilization) on only 3 technologies, leaving no buffer for R&D pivots or exploratory investments expected in a 기술선도 portfolio.
T03 (스테어 바이 와이어) is rated Tier=High rather than Strategic despite being the terminal deliverable, suggesting possible misalignment between investment priority and roadmap role.
Concentrating all investment in a narrow 3-technology sequential chain creates high single-point-of-failure risk with no parallel exploratory tracks.
timing_issues: 3D 포즈 추정 시스템 completes in 2030-Q1 but market boom was 2027-Q4 — a 2.25-year miss that eliminates any first-mover advantage.
스테어 바이 와이어 제어 has identical start and end dates (2030-Q1), implying no actual development time is allocated despite being a complex TRL 7 system.
The sequential dependency chain forces T03 to start only when T08 finishes in 2030-Q1, making it structurally impossible to meet the 2028-Q1 boom window.
